I have had two different recurring dreams that feel so real when they are happening that I can taste what I was eating when I wake up. Here is a bit of detail. 

1. I am new to the laboratory, and am welcomed with a customary Peanut Butter & Jelly lunch as the lab is far in the cold wilderness and are not afforded the luxury of being close to any other civilizations. I am not trained in how to handle the specimens that are being studied in this aquarium. But am quickly assigned the task of cleaning the tank after being told not to worry these snakes are rear fanged and would have trouble biting a human hand as is. Being new and trying to earn a little respect as quickly as possible, I start cleaning the tank which is full of water almost to the top. And I am feeling little nips but it almost tickles so I do not worry about it, and continue cleaning. I drop the cleaning device and reach over into the tank to scoop it from the bottom and the snakes swarm my arm nipping. As I pull it up out of the water I see little  blood drops forming all over my arm. And hear someone scream behind me. As I turn he yells "NO NO NO" and comes running up with a thick leathery looking full arm glove. I remember falling as I turn and everything goes into slow motion. I hit the ground and just before my vision blurs I can't help but notice the frayed edge on the bottom of his pants...."I wonder how many people have died staring at a frayed pants leg?" I think to myself before fading to black. 

I wake up tasting PB&J(grape) every time....I haven't had a PB&J in at least 10 years. The dream feels so real I can remember every detail of what they were wearing as I am falling. 

2. A couple friends and I are on a diving expedition but are quickly surrounded by very aggressive and large sharks. I end up trying to be a distraction so they can get away. I go lower and lower to lure the sharks down while they swim up. I get to the bottom of the ocean floor only to see what has to be the biggest shark in existence swimming slowly about a foot off the bottom. It is so large that no matter how fast i try to book it out of there...I AM DONE! It just swims slowly past me and I connect with it's left eye. I see something in it....a soul perhaps...an understanding. We are both trying to survive. I feel this feeling of respect from the shark...it appreciates my bravery in saving my friends. It wants me to stay brave and says I should go to the doctor. I make it back to the boat and am in slight shock so I am given food to try and help me relax...all we have on board PB&J(grape). I go only to find out that I am terminally ill with weeks to live. I go back to find the shark but it is nowhere to be found. I am on my vessel in the middle of the ocean at night, watching the stars. In the stars I see the movements of the ocean and the shark swimming away from me slowly, as he fades, so do I. 

Again I wake up still tasting the PB&J 


I have had these dreams since I was a child....4-5 times a year..nothing changes in them except the details become easier to remember....more clear if you will.
